per_rule.rule: S_N must never be null because it is the primary identifier for each customer.
All S_N values must be unique across the table.
Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N (one‑to‑one relationship).
Account_No must be exactly four digits.
Names must be in title case (first letter capitalised, rest lower) for each word, except for known particles (bin, binte, s/o, d/o) which are allowed in lower case.
ID_No must match the dominant pattern: a single capital letter, seven digits, then a capital letter (e.g., S1234567D).
Race must be one of the canonical categories: Chinese, Malay, Indian.
Age must be parseable as a numeric value.
Age must be between 13 and 120 inclusive.
Contact_No must not be null because a phone number is required for customer contact.
Contact_No must follow the Singapore international format '+65 XXXXXXXXX' where X is an 8‑digit number.
If Country refers to Singapore (any observed variant), Contact_No must start with '+65 '.
Email must match a simple email pattern: one '@' with no whitespace.
Postal_Code must be a numeric string of length 4 to 6 digits.
Patronymic particles must be consistent with Gender: 'bin' or 's/o' imply Male; 'binte' or 'd/o' imply Female.
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
